annotation.title_clean: Securing Agentic AI: An Addendum to the Guidelines and Companion Guide on Securing AI Systems (Draft for Public Consultation)
annotation.title_en: Securing Agentic AI: An Addendum to the Guidelines and Companion Guide on Securing AI Systems (Draft for Public Consultation)
annotation.summary_en: Singapore CSA's draft consultation addendum to its AI security guidelines, addressing software-based agentic AI systems. It sets a lifecycle, risk-based approach with threat mapping, controls by capability (planning, development, deployment, operations), human-in-the-loop oversight, and case studies. Voluntary, non-prescriptive guidance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Take a lifecycle approach starting with a risk assessment and mapping agentic workflows to threat vectors.
Limit agent autonomy and privileges with roles, access control and short-lived credentials.
Ensure human-in-the-loop oversight and validation for high-risk actions and transactions.
Comprehensive logging with trace identifiers; establish a vulnerability disclosure process.
Guidance is voluntary, non-prescriptive; includes case studies and annexes on MCP and A2A protocols.
